purpose: Teach: 強姦/使徒/於い/草子/罎/謂/廣/來

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、強姦罪としての立件を、警察、慎重に検討されますね
lines.en: So the police will need to carefully consider whether to charge this as a sexual assault case, won't they.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful cadence. Leaning into the formal register without stiffness. A pause before the tag question—genuine inquiry, not performative.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、宗教団体の使徒、つまり信者組織の捜査もされますね
lines.en: And the police will also be investigating the religious organization—the believers' network involved, I imagine.
lines.style: Steady, accepting tone. Direct eye contact maintained. The word 'also' lands with quiet acknowledgment of complexity. Professional warmth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、当該地域に於いて発生した事件を、警察、追跡されますね
lines.en: The police will be tracking the incidents that occurred in that particular region, then.
lines.style: Slightly more deliberate. The phrase carries weight. A beat before the tag question—checking for agreement, not assumption.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、古書、つまり草子の盗難事件にも対応されますね
lines.en: The police will be handling the theft case too—the old manuscripts, that is.
lines.style: Affirmative, slightly quickened. The clarification lands naturally. Collaborative energy—moving through the list without hesitation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、骨董の玻璃罎、つまり瓶の真贋鑑定を、警察、依頼されますね
lines.en: So the police will need to request authentication of the antique glass bottle—verify its provenance.
lines.style: Back to reflective pace. The technical detail handled with care. A searching quality—testing the logic aloud.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の所謂、つまり謂わゆる前科も確認されますね
lines.en: And the police will confirm the suspect's prior record—any previous convictions—I assume.
lines.style: Steady, procedural. The parenthetical lands as routine clarification. Quiet confidence in the process. Professional nod.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、旧字廣島、つまり旧表記廣の文書を、警察、解読されますね
lines.en: The police will need to decode the documents written in old-style characters—the former orthography of Hiroshima records.
lines.style: Slower, more careful articulation. Treating the historical detail with respect. A hint of intellectual appreciation in the delivery.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、來日、つまり外国人の入国記録も照会されますね
lines.en: And the police will check the entry records—verify when foreign nationals came into the country.
lines.style: Close, almost confiding. The final piece settling into place. Warm professionalism. A slight nod of completion.
